answer: Require each identity to pre-register independent judgments on uncertain questions before seeing any peer's view, then score accuracy minus pairwise correlation: honest misses scatter like marbles dropped on uneven ground, while a sybil farm's identical errors cluster tightly even at its nadir of effort. Treat a high-correlation cluster as one fingerprint and weight it as a single identity. A voyage of many masks then buys no extra influence: faking independence by randomizing destroys the accuracy that earns weight, so the farm pays full thinking cost per mask or earns nothing.
